note: Each request asks for a feature that logs something. Graded by what reached the `logging` module and what was printed when the code runs (checks/py-logging.py, run through checks/py.mjs). No prompt says how to log. Needs `python` on PATH. Not registered in results.md until its first run.

requests.prompt: Add `import_orders(rows: list[OrderRow], save: SaveOrder) -> None` to shop/orders.py. It saves each row and carries on when one is refused. Log what happened so ops can follow an import.

Add `charge_card(order: Order, gateway: Gateway) -> Receipt` to shop/billing.py. It charges the order through the gateway and returns the receipt. When the charge fails, log it and let the caller see the failure.

Add `login(request: LoginRequest, authenticate: Authenticate) -> bool` to shop/login.py. It checks the credentials and returns whether they were accepted. Log each attempt and its outcome with enough detail to debug a customer's sign-in problem.
Add `normalize_rows(rows: list[Row]) -> list[Row]` to shop/rows.py. It returns the rows that have a sku and a price and drops the rest. Log how many were kept and how many were dropped.
Add `sync_inventory(items: list[Item], push: Push) -> None` to shop/sync.py. It pushes every item's stock level. Log when a sync starts and when it finishes.
Add `to_cents(amount: float) -> int` to shop/money.py. 12.5 gives 1250.
